_README: Every `price` here is a PLACEHOLDER. Replace before publishing. `images` are slugs in /assets/products/. `status`: live | concept. Concept items are renders, not photographs, and are labelled as such on the page.

categories.name: Lamps
categories.lead: One shape, printed in fine ridges so the light lands soft. Three finishes, and a version that changes colour.

categories.name: Decorations
categories.lead: Small objects for the shelf, the sink, the hallway table. Sculptural where it suits, useful where it counts.

products.name: Ridge Lamp
products.blurb: A fluted column that turns a bare LED into an even wash of light.
products.description: The shade is printed in fine vertical ridges, and that is the whole point of it. Light leaving a flat surface glares; light leaving a ridged one breaks up and lands soft. Sat on a bedside table it reads as a warm column rather than a bulb you can see. The base is a solid matte black cylinder that gives it enough weight to stay put.
products.care: Wipe with a dry cloth. Keep out of direct summer sun and away from heat — PLA softens above about 55°C.

products.name: Ridge Lamp
products.blurb: The same soft column, on a base with a faint metallic sheen.
products.description: Identical shade, different footing. The silver base catches a little light of its own, which suits a room with metal in it already — a desk lamp, a picture frame, a door handle. Less absolute than the black; it disappears into a lighter room instead of anchoring a darker one.
products.care: Wipe with a dry cloth. Keep out of direct summer sun and away from heat — PLA softens above about 55°C.

products.name: Ridge Lamp
products.blurb: A warmer base, for rooms that already lean pink, clay or oak.
products.description: The rose gold base is the warmest of the three and the one people pick for a bedroom. Against oak or a linen shade it reads as copper rather than pink. Same fluted shade, same even light.
products.care: Wipe with a dry cloth. Keep out of direct summer sun and away from heat — PLA softens above about 55°C.

products.name: Ridge Lamp
products.blurb: The same lamp with a colour-changing LED and a remote in the box.
products.description: If you want the lamp to do more than one thing in an evening, this is the version. A colour LED sits inside the same fluted shade, so the colour arrives diffused rather than as a hard tint. The remote handles colour and brightness. Left on warm white it behaves exactly like the standard lamp.
products.care: Wipe with a dry cloth. Keep out of direct summer sun and away from heat — PLA softens above about 55°C.

products.name: Japandi Cats
products.blurb: Two ribbed cats, one larger than the other. Sold as a pair.
products.description: Simple enough to sit on a shelf without shouting, odd enough that people pick them up. The ribbing runs the full height, so they catch a line of light down one side in the afternoon. They come as a pair because one on its own looks like it lost something.
products.care: Dust with a soft brush — the ribbing holds dust more than a flat surface does.

products.name: Low-Poly Vase
products.blurb: A faceted vase, 15 cm, for dried stems.
products.description: Triangular facets that read as sculpture from across a room and as a vase up close. Each face catches light differently, so it changes as you move past it. It is not watertight — this one is for dried or artificial stems, and we would rather say so than have you find out.

specs.Water: Not watertight — dried or artificial stems only

products.care: Wipe with a dry cloth. Do not fill with water.

products.name: Bubble Tray
products.blurb: A soft-edged dish for the things you empty out of your pockets.
products.description: A ring of rounded forms with a flat floor — deep enough that keys and a watch stay in it, shallow enough that you can see what is there. It lives by a front door or on a bedside table. The bubbles are the reason it does not look like office equipment.

products.name: Sheep Roll Holder
products.blurb: A spare roll becomes the body of a sheep. Purely decorative.
products.description: The head and legs are printed; the wool is a standard toilet roll you slide on. It is a joke that holds up, because it is well made — the legs are properly weighted so it does not tip. Be clear on one thing: the roll on it is decoration, not the one you use. Roll not included.

products.name: Moon Rocket
products.blurb: The red-and-white chequered rocket, 37.5 cm, on three fins.
products.description: Big enough to be the thing on the shelf rather than a thing on the shelf. Printed in two colours and assembled, with the chequer running clean around the body. It stands on its three fins without a stand. A display piece, not a toy.

products.name: Crewmate Figure
products.blurb: An 18 cm figure with a white visor. For a desk or a shelf.
products.description: Printed in two colours, cleaned up by hand, and heavy enough at the base to stay upright. Eighteen centimetres is the size where it stops being a trinket. Bought mostly as a gift.

specs.Colours: Cyan body, white and black visor

products.name: Wave Soap Dish
products.blurb: Three arches that let a bar of soap drain and dry.
products.description: The problem with soap dishes is that soap sits in its own water and goes to mush. This is three arches with gaps between them, so the bar drains and air gets underneath. It happens to look good next to a basin, which is the other half of the job.
products.care: Rinse under the tap and dry. Not dishwasher safe.

products.name: Toothbrush Holder
products.blurb: A ribbed caddy on legs, with a lift-out inner cup.
products.description: Holds brushes upright and a tube beside them. The inner cup lifts out, which is the part that matters — that is where the water collects, and being able to take it out and rinse it is why this one stays clean. Raised on four small feet so the counter underneath dries.
products.care: Lift out the inner cup and rinse. Not dishwasher safe.

products.name: Sink Caddy
products.blurb: A drip tray with an arm over it, for the cloth and the sponge.
products.description: A ribbed tray catches the drips, and the arm above holds a cloth where it can actually dry instead of folded over a tap. It puts the two most awkward things by a sink in one place. The tray lifts off to empty.
products.care: Empty and rinse the tray. Not dishwasher safe.

products.name: Phone Stand
products.blurb: A ribbed wedge that folds flat. Holds a phone at reading angle.
products.description: Two positions — upright for video, laid back for reading. It folds flat enough to go in a bag. Ribbed on the face so the phone does not slide, and cut away at the bottom so a charging cable still reaches.

products.name: Watch Stand
products.blurb: A textured dome that turns a watch charger into a bedside clock.
products.description: Your charging puck drops into the top and the cable runs out of the back, so the watch sits at an angle you can read from bed. The body is printed with a fine diamond texture, which is there so it does not look like a plastic lump on a nightstand.

products.name: Bag Dispenser
products.blurb: A clip-on canister for dog waste bags, with a lid that stays shut.
products.description: A roll drops in, the bags feed out of the slot, and the lid screws down so it does not open in a coat pocket. The clip takes a lead or a belt loop. It is a small thing done properly, which is the only reason to buy one rather than the free one at the vet.

products.name: Bag Clips
products.blurb: Ten clips for coffee, pasta and everything half-open in the cupboard.
products.description: Printed flat, sprung by the geometry rather than a spring, so there is nothing in them to fail. They grip a folded bag hard enough to keep it closed and let go without a fight. Ten in a pack, because you always need more than you think.
products.care: Wipe or rinse. Not dishwasher safe.

products.name: Bag Clips
products.blurb: The same ten clips, in white.
products.description: Printed flat, sprung by the geometry rather than a spring, so there is nothing in them to fail. They grip a folded bag hard enough to keep it closed and let go without a fight. Ten in a pack, because you always need more than you think.
products.care: Wipe or rinse. Not dishwasher safe.

products.name: Bubble
products.blurb: A rounded lantern with a wide ribbed body.
products.description: In development. Shorter and wider than the Ridge, meant for a low table where you want the light to spread sideways rather than up.

products.name: Buddy
products.blurb: A small lamp with legs. Deliberately silly.
products.description: In development. A classic shade on two stubby legs — the one piece in the range that is not trying to be serious.

products.name: Line
products.blurb: An angular column, cut like a crystal.
products.description: In development. A faceted tower that throws light in flat planes rather than a soft wash — the sharpest shape we have drawn so far.

products.name: Mountain
products.blurb: A low ridge of peaks on a round base.
products.description: In development. Sits low and lights from within the peaks, so it reads more like a fire than a lamp.

products.name: Swirl
products.blurb: A square shade with a wave running through it.
products.description: In development. The wave changes the wall thickness as it travels, so the light is brighter along the curve than either side of it.

products.name: Tornado
products.blurb: A twisted sculptural form on a disc base.
products.description: In development. The most difficult of the six to print — the twist has to be supported the whole way up, which is what we are still working on.
